summary: Antelope Enterprise Holdings Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $100,000,000 of Class A ordinary shares through D. Boral Capital LLC as sales agent or principal under a Sales Agreement dated October 1, 2026. D. Boral receives 2.5% commission on gross sales and is not obligated to sell any specific amount; no escrow is used. AEHL closed at $8.59 on September 29, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and any selling pressure from ATM issuance.
